sql: SELECT d.date AS ds, SUM(d.total_passengers) AS y FROM daily_passenger_stats d WHERE d.route_id = '22' AND TRIM(d.operator) = 'HTX-VTHANG' GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
sql_explanation: Retrieves the daily total passengers (y) for Route 22 operated by HTX-VTHANG (d.route_id = '22' and d.operator = 'HTX-VTHANG') over the specified time period (d.date).
